expectedIssues: Fastest near you carousel card heights are misaligned with each other
reportedIssues: The cards in the "Fastest near you" horizontal scroll row have inconsistent heights. Because the background images have different natural aspect ratios, the text beneath them (e.g., "Green Bowl Poké" vs "Smash Bros Burgers") is misaligned vertically, creating a jagged, broken-looking carousel.
The "15-25 min" delivery time badge on the "Green Bowl Poké" card is a white pill placed over a mostly white food image, making the badge boundaries nearly invisible and the text harder to read.
